description: Zero-shot evaluation of models/branch1_v1 + models/branch2_v1 (no retraining) against a stratified sample of the newly-found Kaggle dataset data/raw/superviz25/dataset.csv. Purpose: decide whether this dataset's pattern is compatible enough to cite as an additional validation set, or whether it requires retraining.
caveats: Source dataset's own `split` column is unusable for supervised training as given (train split = 100% benign, all attacks in test) — ignored here in favor of our own stratified sample.
attack_technique='insider' rows inspected by hand and look mislabeled (plain session-init SQL like 'SET NAMES utf8mb4' tagged as attack) — reported separately, not treated as ground truth.
attack_technique='inline' does not map to any of Branch 1's 5 classes (canary/fuzz-probe payloads, not a SQLi sub-technique) — reported separately, unmapped.
This is a stratified sample (reservoir sampling per stratum, seed =42), not the full 3.69M-row dataset — sized for stable FPR/DR estimates, not exhaustive coverage.

benign_plain.interpretation: flag_rate here = false positive rate (ground truth is benign)

union.interpretation: flag_rate here = detection rate (ground truth is attack)
